reviews.name: Razeena Bhol
reviews.text: This is a very cute Café. Love the atmosphere. Food is tasty. Overall a good experience. It was very busy the day we had gone and food had been delayed quite a bit. The good service however makes up for delays and look forward to going back. Parking however is an issue and maybe a plan can be made for customers?

reviews.name: Rooibos Poppy Gal
reviews.text:
This restaurant is conveniently
situated between Claremont and Lansdowne. The menu is fully halaal with kiddy options too. Food is decent and tastes okay.  There is a lovely wide variety of quality tea options... but beverages are sadly over priced here.

reviews.name: Natasha Petersen
reviews.text: Delicious food and outstanding service! The café has a fantastic vintage music theme with vinyl records decorating the space, creating a warm and nostalgic atmosphere. A great spot to relax and enjoy a good meal.

reviews.name: ILHAAM RYKLIEF
reviews.text: Their burgers are on another level...really good and fulfilling...but dont take my word for it....go try it for yourself. ..Quality is of the highest order. Service was excellent. The atmosphere was serene. Went midweek and wasn't as busy as a weekend I suppose. Their cheesecake was divine...had the biscoff cheesecake and could definitely give #Serendepity a run for their money. All in all....definitely worth it! Got the deal on wikideals and including drinks spent under R150 each...there were 4 of us.

reviews.name: Zaida Da Silva Bastra
reviews.text:
Cute and cosy.
Friendly and helpful staff
Wifi available.

Menu has great options.
Decor and placement for what's on offer is great.
Games are available to play whilst there.

Tea and coffee selections at the entrance .

Didn't have to wait long and the food was delectable. The drinks were ok.

Recommended your place and my brother took mom & her sister this morning for breakfast.

I visited your site behind Kenilworth Centre about 2 years ago and enjoyed a delicious breakfast there.  The last picture is the sign from inside that space.

Will visit again!
